reference.description: re-computes multiscale entropy (per scale) with NeuroKit2 entropy_multiscale (MSEn) on the identical signal and confirms multiscaleEntropy reproduces the per-scale curve bit-for-bit; reports representative scales, the mean (complexity index), the peak scale, whether coarse-scale MSE exceeds scale 1, and the sample count
